articles.title: India Beat Pakistan by One Wicket in Last-Ball U19 Asia Cup Final
articles.excerpt: Chasing 338 at Al Amerat, India recovered from 252 for eight to finish on 339 for nine off the final ball — Mohit Ulva unbeaten on 49 — and claim a record ninth U19 Asia Cup title.
articles.nri_angle: A last-ball India-Pakistan final is the fixture diaspora fans follow most closely at age-group level, and this one delivered a record ninth continental title for India.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.excerpt: The hub, launched November 13, will build AI and data products for athlete performance, talent identification and fan engagement. KPMG values India's sports industry at about $21 billion today.
articles.nri_angle: The hub's fan-engagement and streaming work is aimed at an audience that includes the diaspora following Indian leagues from abroad.

articles.title: India Face Pakistan in U19 Asia Cup Final, Chasing a Record Ninth Title
articles.excerpt: Raichandani's India meet unbeaten defending champions Pakistan in Al Amerat on Saturday at 10:30 a.m. IST — 9 p.m. Friday on the US West Coast — after Pakistan won their group meeting by three wickets.
articles.nri_angle: The final starts at 10:30 a.m. IST on Saturday, which is 9:00 p.m. PT on Friday and midnight ET — a prime-time watch for diaspora fans in North America.

articles.title: Ares Management Reportedly in Talks for Minority Stake in Kolkata Knight Riders
articles.excerpt: Moneycontrol reporting says the US asset manager is in advanced discussions over about 20% of the IPL franchise from the Mehta Group, at a valuation of over $1.8 billion — with no final agreement reached.
articles.image_caption: The Eden Gardens stadium just before the beginning of the Indian Premier League match between the Kolkata Knight Riders and the Chennai Super Kings, on the 18th of May, 2008. US alternative asset manager Ares Management is reportedly in talks to acquire a minority stake in Kolkata Knight Riders, according to Moneycontrol reporting cited in fresh reports this week — no final agreement has been reached.
articles.image_credit: Photo: Partha Bhaumik via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 2.0)
articles.nri_angle: KKR's owner group also runs the Los Angeles Knight Riders in Major League Cricket, so a US institutional buyer for the IPL franchise would deepen the Knight Riders brand's American footprint.

articles.title: Gambhir 'Concerned' by India's Batting Collapses After 244-Run Rout in New Zealand
articles.excerpt: India folded for 89 chasing 334 at Mount Maunganui, their second-heaviest ODI defeat. The head coach said the repeat collapses — not one bad innings — are the problem, in conditions he called the closest thing to next year's World Cup.
articles.nri_angle: Diaspora fans watching the New Zealand tour are seeing the exact conditions India will face at the 2027 World Cup in Southern Africa — which is why Gambhir is treating a bilateral collapse as a warning, not a blip.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Harmanpreet Kaur Unveils Wax Statue in Jaipur, Says 171 Knock Changed Women's Cricket
articles.excerpt: The former India captain's figure will stand permanently beside Tendulkar and Dhoni at Nahargarh Fort. At the unveiling she credited her 171-run innings with changing perceptions, and told young women cricketers to bat like Vaibhav Sooryavanshi.
articles.nri_angle: For diaspora fans who watched the 171 and the World Cup run from abroad, the Jaipur statue marks women's cricket's arrival in the same hall of fame long reserved for Tendulkar, Dhoni and Kohli.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.excerpt: Subhajit Banerjee and Suresh Singh summited the 6,027-metre Miyar Valley peak on 22 September via a new West Ridge line named Moonlight Spur.
articles.nri_angle: The self-reliant, no-fixed-rope ascent is a Himalayan mountaineering milestone that Indian adventure readers abroad can follow through the full expedition account.

articles.excerpt: An early Bijoy Varghese own goal, a Jesse Randall brace, and second-half goals from Chris Wood and Lachlan Bayliss gave New Zealand a 5-0 win in the opening match of India's New Zealand tour; the sides meet again in Christchurch on Sunday.
articles.image_caption: India's starting eleven pose for a team photograph before the friendly at Go Media Stadium in Auckland. New Zealand won the match 5-0, with Jesse Randall scoring twice.
articles.nri_angle: India's first match in New Zealand drew the diaspora's football fans in Auckland; the second friendly in Christchurch on Sunday, November 15 is the next chance to watch the Blue Tigers in person or on the morning IST broadcast.

articles.title: Unbeaten 249-Run Stand Puts Sri Lanka Within 30 Runs of Pakistan in Rawalpindi
articles.excerpt: Dhananjaya de Silva (167 not out) and captain Kusal Mendis (117 not out) batted through Day 3 of the first Test, taking Sri Lanka to 404 for 4 against Pakistan's 434 for 9 declared, with Pakistan taking only one wicket all day.
articles.nri_angle: A record Rawalpindi fifth-wicket stand in a Pakistan-Sri Lanka Test — the kind of subcontinental contest South Asian diaspora fans follow closely.

articles.image_caption: Shreyanka Patil bowls for India in a T20 international. She has been named in all three India A squads for the England A series starting November 30.

articles.excerpt: Dropped months after captaining India to a T20 World Cup title defence, the 36-year-old credited his wife Devisha and his baby daughter with helping him rediscover his love for the game before leading Mumbai in the Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy.
articles.image_caption: Suryakumar Yadav sits with the T20 World Cup trophy after India's title win in March 2026. The former captain has spoken publicly about being dropped from the side and rediscovering his love for the game.

articles.title: Ashwin Says Only Bumrah Is Locked In as India's 2027 World Cup Pace Race Tightens
articles.excerpt: R Ashwin said Jasprit Bumrah is the only fast bowler certain of a 2027 ODI World Cup place, and that Mohammed Siraj, for all his experience, is not a lock given how little ODI cricket India have given him. Prasidh Krishna, Arshdeep Singh and Anshul Kamboj are all in the race, he said.

articles.title: Tickner and Ferguson Ruled Out as New Zealand Reshuffle Again for India ODIs
articles.excerpt: Blair Tickner must serve a seven-day stand-down despite being cleared of concussion, Lockie Ferguson is out for the series with a calf tear, and Kristian Clarke comes in as cover with India leading 2-0 before Tuesday's Hamilton match.
articles.nri_angle: For India fans following the tour from abroad, Tuesday's third ODI in Hamilton is now a series decider in effect: India lead 2-0, and a win closes the five-match series against a reshuffled home attack.

articles.title: Shourya Ambure Wins Bronze, India's First Track Medal at Dakar Youth Olympics
articles.excerpt: The 17-year-old from Maharashtra clocked a personal best 13.59 seconds in the women's 100m hurdles final, missing silver by 0.02 seconds as India's only track and field athlete at the Games.
articles.image_caption: Shourya Ambure, wearing her AMBURE race bib and India kit, holds the Indian flag after the women's 100m hurdles final at Dakar 2026. She won bronze in a personal best 13.59 seconds, India's first track and field medal of the Games.
articles.nri_angle: Ambure's medal gives Indian athletics a new junior name to follow toward the senior circuit — she has now medalled at the Asian U18 Championships, the Asian Youth Games and the Youth Olympics inside 18 months.
